# A USD receivable settled out of a CAD bank, so the transaction's currency is
# not the currency of the split that settles it.
#
# The bank side is 137.00 CAD and the receivable side is −100.00 USD. Reported
# under the transaction's currency, the receivable's figure reads "100.00 CAD"
# — the wrong money, and at CAD's number of decimals. A split's amount is in
# its account's commodity, and this is the shape where the two part company.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_foreign_currency_cost_basis.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-FX"
	name: "FX Customer"
	currency: USD

invoice "INV-FX-CAD-BANK"
	customer_id: "C-FX"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-FX-CAD-BANK"
		accumulate: true
